accepted_scopes: For every odd prime q, N=2q equality-mask degrees are exactly 1,2,q,2q.
For primes p<q and N=pq, possible degrees d<q are exactly 1,p.
For primes p<q and N=pq, no equality-mask degree satisfies (p-1)q<d<pq.
remaining: General mixed-prime necessity outside these scopes and prior accepted cases; exact nonsharp optima and sharp gap rates; historical priority.
